description: A Spring Boot controller class providing basic utility endpoints such as welcome, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing utility endpoints such as welcome message, documentation redirect, health status, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a greeting message indicating the application is running.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects users to the Swagger UI for API documentation.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a simple health check status of the application.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Returns basic information about the application.
